description: Displays all brief microcopy strings (input prompt, success message, duplicate entry message, and error messages) throughout the user interface to guide the student through recording their daily win

props.text: Displays all brief microcopy strings (input prompt, success message, duplicate entry message, and error messages) throughout the user interface to guide the student through recording their daily win
Displays 'What is one win from today?' above or within the input field
Shows 'Today's win is saved.' after successful save action
Displays 'Today's win is already recorded. Come back tomorrow.' when user attempts second entry same day
Shows clear and supportive error messages for general failures
